snippet.title: Become - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
You were one of millions and made it. Experience life's fantastic journey. 
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3710850/Become/ 
Discord: https://discord.gg/AqR5Xpvx2M

Survive the microcosm dangers, wiggle, dash and compete through the human reproductive system and create new life. Become is a small indie adventure game by Valentin Wirth. 

Genre: Single player, third-person adventure, exploration, survival 
Playtime: 2-3 hours linear experience 
Platforms: PC (Steam) Release: 2026 

Credits: 
Developer & Publisher: Valentin Wirth 
UI and Programming: Marek Nesvadba 
Music and Trailer SFX by 4boars: https://4boars.com 
Logo: María Cerro

#BecomeGame #indiegame #indiedev #gametrailer
